protocol.estimator: One intercept-only residual correction per domain. Compute each eligible training history's mean (actual minus baseline) across its targets, then average histories equally. No scenario label, seed, future headcount, opening count or instrument metadata enters prediction. Hiring actuals are cohort fractions, with zero-opening targets unavailable. Same estimator and fixed settings for nested sample sizes.
protocol.calibrationRule: Separate common calibration histories at the training origin, with labels available before test origin. Per domain and variant take each history's maximum absolute error across target periods; use order statistic ceil((n+1)*0.9). Require at least 20 usable histories. Clip diagnostic bands to the target's support. Evaluate whole-history simultaneous coverage. This is an empirical residual-envelope diagnostic, not an established conformal guarantee under temporal/scenario shift.
protocol.fitFreeze: Commit protocol before any new-seed generation. Generate training/calibration, freeze their fitted corrections and diagnostic radii with hashes in a separate commit, then generate test histories. Test checks may reproduce only frozen fits, never choose models or thresholds.
protocol.comparison: Report every family/domain and abstention. Primary paired comparisons are expanded minus small per-history MAE and RMSE, plus wins/ties/losses. Report unchanged baseline too. Equal-history aggregation; no significance claim, no automatic promotion or new consumer artifact.
protocol.controls: Stationary hiring fractions and survey scores have no expected trend; stationary turnover has stock/seasonality signal. July 2026 reversal is unseen in training and has no scenario input. Reporting-stress tests lag/revision behavior; a separate November 2025 replay tests native partial turnover and survey support. Hiring lacks persistent missing mature cohorts in this generator; existing strict adapter tests cover that failure. Survey-break labels are incomparable and must abstain.
protocol.scope: New independent seeded cases from the unchanged 72-month generator; no reconstruction of original data or historical source availability. Prior datasets, reports, UI/AI contracts, database/security/eNPS remain unchanged.
protocol.reserve: October–December target periods/cohorts are unscored. July–September hiring cohorts use 90-day follow-up overlapping the later calendar quarter.

trainingFreeze.custody: Training and calibration committed before first test generation. Named Git commit contents and ancestry independently checked before test stage. No independent external blinding.

metricUnits.hiring: fraction of each all-opening cohort started within 90 days
metricUnits.satisfaction: quarterly mean respondent favorable-answer share in percentage points

aggregation: Equal history weights; equal target-cohort/month weights within history. Hiring fraction error is not opening-weighted Brier/log loss. Mean history RMSE is not pooled RMSE.
limitations: One nested training-size comparison, not a general learning curve.
Generator family labels are evaluation strata only, never correction-model features.
Calibration is from an earlier time and a different regime mix; nominal 90% envelopes have no established test coverage guarantee.
Synthetic seeds do not add real-world evidence, previously missing inputs or new causal mechanisms.
Independent RNG streams and frozen seeds are not independent external custody or real populations.
